lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrSb₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell (Sr₄Sb₈O₂₀) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Sb centers coordinated by six O neighbors, and square-pyramidal Sr centers coordinated by five O neighbors. The Sb octahedra share corners and edges with one another and edges with Sr square pyramids, and the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional. These coordination and connectivity results come from the supplied CrystalNN geometry-only analysis.
